reason: I already paid for a mass-DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so anything that sends DMs for me from my own Instagram makes me flinch, however nicely it's worded. There are zero results or case studies, and a refund of $147 doesn't give me back an account that got restricted.
objection: No proof it books calls, and the real risk is my Instagram account, not the $147. A refund doesn't un-block my account or give back the weeks I'd lose, and 'at the default pace' sounds like a loophole.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from people like me, such as a few named coaches or agency owners showing booked calls from this exact tool, plus the preview showing 10 DMs that don't read like a template. Even then I'd test it on a second account first.
